requirements.title: Complete Framework Infrastructure
requirements.description: Implement all 14 framework requirements focusing on infrastructure, configuration, and tooling - NOT on writing actual Playwright tests
acceptance_criteria: Data adapters exist and work (Excel, JSON, DB, S3) - already implemented
Multi-environment .env files (dev, stage, prod) with proper loading - already implemented
playwright.config.ts has comprehensive inline comments explaining WHAT/WHY/HOW for each section
src/common/ folder structure with base-page.ts, ui-common.ts, api-client.ts for shared utilities
Markdown specs system with templates in tests/specs/ directories
Page objects follow pattern: CSV locators at top, methods below (already partially done)
Ignore EspoCRM target (user explicitly said ignore)
Test files are thin/modular using common utilities and data adapters
CI/CD pipelines: Jenkinsfile for Windows, Jenkinsfile for Ubuntu, GitHub Actions workflow, Azure DevOps pipeline
Defect handling configured: traces, logs, videos, screenshots on failure (already in playwright.config.ts)
MCP system exists in tooling/qa/ (already implemented)
Reporters configured: HTML, JSON, Allure, List (already in playwright.config.ts)
API testing infrastructure in src/api/ for future API tests
Specs in .md format with converter utility

requirements.title: Framework Completion with Cleanup (Professional Delivery)
requirements.description: Complete all remaining requirements with repository cleanup, thin test refactoring, comprehensive documentation, API test infrastructure, and Playwright MCP research
acceptance_criteria: Repository cleanup: Consolidate config folders (configs/ + config/ → config/), move test data to config/test-data/, delete empty legacy folders (pages/, utils/)
Req #2: Credentials fetched from Excel/DB/S3 via credential-loader.ts (not hardcoded .env)
Req #9: Tests refactored to <10 lines using ui-common.ts workflow methods (navigateToAuthenticatedPage, verifyElementWithRetry, etc.)
Req #6: All .spec.ts files have corresponding .spec.md documentation for non-technical stakeholders
Req #14: API test infrastructure with .spec.ts + .spec.md files for authentication and token management
Req #4: Framework-wide FILE:/PURPOSE/WHY/HOW comments in all src/ files
Req #12: Playwright MCP protocol research documented in docs/PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_RESEARCH.md
